features: Powerful 2.1 Channel Home Theatre with Wired Subwoofer: Upgrade your entertainment with this 2.1 channel home theatre system featuring a powerful wired subwoofer for deep bass and immersive cinematic sound at home.

100W HD Soundbar with Deep Bass Output: Experience crystal-clear audio and punchy low frequencies with the 100W HD soundbar, designed to enhance movies, music, gaming, and TV shows with theatre-like sound.
Bluetooth 5.3 Wireless Connectivity: Stream music seamlessly with Bluetooth 5.3 in this advanced home theatre soundbar. Enjoy stable, faster connections and lag-free audio performance.
Multiple EQ Modes for Custom Audio Experience: Switch between different EQ modes to optimize sound output for movies, music, news, or gaming. This smart soundbar adapts to your content effortlessly.
Wide Compatibility – HDMI, AUX & USB-C: Connect this home theatre soundbar easily via HDMI, AUX in, or USB-C input. Compatible with TVs, laptops, smartphones, gaming consoles, and more.
Sleek Soundbar Design with LED Strip Light: The premium matte-finish soundbar features a stylish LED strip light that adds a modern touch to your home décor while delivering powerful performance.
Easy Control with Dedicated Remote: Control volume, bass, EQ modes, and playback with the included sleek remote. This home theatre system ensures convenient operation from anywhere in the room.

Designed for immersive movie nights, binge-worthy series, gaming sessions, and music streaming, this home theatre system transforms your living room into a cinematic sound zone. The advanced soundbar produces crisp highs, clear vocals, and balanced mids, while the wired subwoofer enhances low frequencies for impactful bass you can truly feel. With Bluetooth 5.3 connectivity, enjoy seamless wireless streaming with stable and lag-free performance. Multiple EQ modes allow you to customize the audio output according to your content—whether it’s action-packed movies, dialogue-heavy shows, or energetic playlists. Wide compatibility options including HDMI, AUX in, and USB-C ensure effortless connectivity with TVs, laptops, gaming consoles, and smartphones. The sleek, modern soundbar design features an elegant LED strip light that adds a premium touch to your space.
